purpose: Descriptive design-appropriate critical appraisal and a separate project-defined precision/assay profile. No composite score, rank, exclusion threshold, or GRADE certainty rating.
record_unit: One record per report_id and appraised analysis; link report_id, study_id, and cohort_id so multiple reports/analyses do not double-count participants.

tool_selection.note: Use a tool only when its design/question applies. Do not apply JBI RCT/RoB 2 to all studies. JBI DTA is for an actual index-test/reference-standard diagnostic accuracy question. PROBAST+AI retains its published scope for diagnostic and prognostic prediction-model studies; for this review, trigger it for a genuine individual-level model predicting a defined future outcome, including a future immune-response outcome. A contemporaneous exercise-versus-control classifier, discovery classifier, group-level association, clustering, or descriptive omics analysis alone does not trigger it.

tool_registry.method_paper: Barker TH et al. JBI Evid Synth. 2023;21(3):494-506.
tool_registry.selection_note: For randomized parallel or crossover exercise interventions. For crossover designs also narratively note sequence, period, washout/carryover, and paired analysis; no extra score.

tool_registry.method_paper: Barker TH et al. JBI Evid Synth. 2024;22(3):378-388.
tool_registry.selection_note: For non-randomized exercise interventions and one-group acute pre/post challenges with an identifiable bout and comparator/baseline.

tool_registry.method_paper: Barker TH et al. JBI Evid Synth. 2025;23(3):441-453.
tool_registry.selection_note: For observational exposure-defined longitudinal cohorts; repeated measurements alone do not make a cohort.

tool_registry.tool_name: JBI analytical cross-sectional studies risk-of-bias assessment, revised
tool_registry.method_paper: Barker TH et al. JBI Evid Synth. 2026;24(3):401-408.
tool_registry.selection_note: Habitual-exercise-only cross-sectional evidence is background under v2 and excluded from the core A/B appraisal denominator unless separately labeled as contextual.

tool_registry.method_paper: Use the current checklist linked from the live JBI directory; no revised-tool publication date asserted here.
tool_registry.selection_note: Only for a true outcome-sampled case-control design.

tool_registry.tool_name: JBI diagnostic test accuracy studies checklist
tool_registry.method_paper: JBI Critical Appraisal Tools directory links JBI Manual for Evidence Synthesis, Chapter 9 (2020).
tool_registry.selection_note: Only for an index assay tested against a stated reference standard for a defined target condition. Do not classify a biomarker association or exploratory pathway analysis as DTA.

tool_registry.method_paper: Moons KGM et al. PROBAST+AI: an updated quality, risk of bias, and applicability assessment tool for prediction models using regression or artificial intelligence methods. BMJ. 2025;388:e082505. doi:10.1136/bmj-2024-082505.
tool_registry.selection_note: Published PROBAST+AI scope covers diagnostic and prognostic prediction-model development, updating, and evaluation using regression or AI/ML. This review applies it when an individual-level model predicts a defined future outcome, including a future immune-response outcome; this is the review's tool-selection rule, not a restriction on the instrument's general scope. A contemporaneous exercise-versus-control or molecular discovery classifier does not trigger it. Specify development and/or evaluation, and distinguish apparent, internal, and external validation.

status_codes.coding_note: Keep any source instrument's exact answer label in tool_response_verbatim. No report information is usually tool_response_normalized=UNCLEAR and reporting_status=NR, not NO. NR means not reported; it does not mean failed or absent. NA requires a rationale. Status codes are descriptive, not points or a scale.

items.evidence_locator: PDF page; section/table/figure/supplement or stable URL

appraisal_record_template.precision_profile_note: Dimensions are reported separately and are not a validated scale, composite score, or ladder. Independent validation and tested decision use are recorded as separate facets within one protocol domain.

process.calibration: Use the 10 purposively selected calibration/boundary reports to clarify design selection and item evidence locators; these do not create included-study counts. The screening pilot agreement threshold does not apply to appraisal.
process.disagreement_resolution: Discussion first; then the predesignated adjudicator if unresolved. The adjudicator's identity is pending and must be supplied before formal appraisal.
process.reporting: Preserve both initial appraisals and consensus; summarize concerns descriptively by design without total score, ranking, appraisal-based exclusion, GRADE, or clinical recommendations.
